description: Implementation of a POSIX timer-based GPT (General Purpose Timer) driver for AUTOSAR, managing multiple timer channels with start, stop, notification, and mode control functionalities.

methods.name: ts_to_ns
methods.description: Converts a timespec structure to nanoseconds.

methods.name: ns_to_itimerspec
methods.description: Converts nanoseconds to an itimerspec structure, setting interval based on periodic flag.

methods.name: gpt_timer_sigev_thread
methods.description: Callback function invoked when POSIX timer expires; calls notification callback if enabled.

methods.name: ticks_to_ns
methods.description: Converts timer ticks to nanoseconds based on channel configuration.

methods.name: Gpt_Init
methods.description: Initializes the GPT driver with provided configuration, creating timers for each channel.

methods.name: Gpt_DeInit
methods.description: Deinitializes the GPT driver, deleting timers and freeing resources.

methods.name: Gpt_StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer channel with specified value.

methods.name: Gpt_GetTimeElapsed
methods.description: Returns elapsed time in ticks for a timer channel.

methods.name: Gpt_GetTimeRemaining
methods.description: Returns remaining time in ticks for a timer channel.

methods.name: Gpt_EnableNotification
methods.description: Enables notification callback for a timer channel.

methods.name: Gpt_DisableNotification
methods.description: Disables notification callback for a timer channel.

methods.name: Gpt_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the driver mode (e.g., normal, sleep).
